nodes.label: Docker Unified Networking Pattern

nodes.label: FSM State Synchronization Pattern
nodes.rationale: Binds frontend UI action buttons and badges strictly to backend finite state machine states.

nodes.label: Prompt Execution Protocol
nodes.rationale: Specifies session prompts for implementing all 25 modules in sequence with strict pre-flight checks.

nodes.label: Tenant & Audit Metadata Mixin
nodes.rationale: Standardizes tenant_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, and soft-delete flags across all models.

nodes.label: Role-Based Access Control & Permission Matrix
nodes.rationale: Enforces Buyer, Approver, Supplier, and Superadmin permissions using FastAPI dependency injection.

nodes.label: Generic Finite State Machine Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates entity state transitions, guard condition evaluations, and transition audit logs.

nodes.label: Quorum Approval Convergence

nodes.label: Declarative Approval Rules Engine
nodes.rationale: Evaluates entity attributes (amount, department, category) against prioritized approval rules.

nodes.label: Automated Compliance & KYC Verification

nodes.label: Vendor Lifecycle FSM

nodes.label: Business Unit Sequenced PR Identification

nodes.label: PR Consolidation & Sourcing Assignment
nodes.rationale: A-08-2: Allows buyers to aggregate up to 10 approved PR line items into unified sourcing packages.

nodes.label: Purchase Requisition FSM
nodes.rationale: Transitions PRs from Draft through Review, Approval, Rejection, to Sourcing or PO creation.

nodes.label: Unmapped Requisition Triage Queue
nodes.rationale: A-09-1: Queues ERP-imported PRs lacking category_id or business_unit_id for specialist resolution.

nodes.label: Historical ML-Assisted Item Mapping
nodes.rationale: A-09-2: Leverages historical mapping logs (100+ records) to predict category and catalog mappings.

nodes.label: RFQ Lifecycle State Machine
nodes.rationale: Governs RFQ states through Draft, Published, Open, In Review, Evaluated, and Awarded.

nodes.label: Time-Bounded Bid Submission Window
nodes.rationale: A-10-1: Enforces minimum bidding windows (72 hours standard, 24 hours emergency) before evaluation.

nodes.label: Immutable Bid Versioning System
nodes.rationale: A-11-2: Preserves prior bid revisions in bid_versions table to maintain complete submission audits.

nodes.label: Auditable CS Matrix PDF Generation
nodes.rationale: Generates signed PDF comparative statement matrices for procurement committee approval.

nodes.label: Multi-Factor Scoring & Evaluation Engine
nodes.rationale: A-12-2: Calculates combined vendor evaluation scores based on configurable technical and commercial weights.

nodes.label: Contract Lifecycle FSM
nodes.rationale: Tracks contract states across Draft, Legal Review, Signature, Active, Milestone Execution, and Expiry.

nodes.label: Dual-Provider E-Signature Adapter
nodes.rationale: A-13-1: Integrates Digio for domestic Indian e-sign compliance with DocuSign fallback for overseas vendors.

nodes.label: Contract Milestone & SLA Monitoring
nodes.rationale: A-13-2: Celery tasks monitor contract milestone completion and midnight UTC expiration schedules.

nodes.label: Automated PO Generation from Award
nodes.rationale: A-14-1: Converts awarded comparative statements or executed contracts into POs with BU sequences.

nodes.label: Purchase Order Lifecycle FSM
nodes.rationale: Guides purchase orders through Draft, Issuance, Acknowledgment, Fulfillment, and Final Closure.

nodes.label: Vendor PO Acknowledgment SLA
nodes.rationale: A-14-2: Enforces vendor PO acknowledgment window via supplier portal before triggering alerts.

nodes.label: Invoice Processing FSM
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates invoice workflow: Received, Under Matching, Discrepancy, Approved, Paid, Cancelled.

nodes.label: Payment Schedule & Business Day Due Date Calculator
nodes.norm_label: payment schedule & business day due date calculator
nodes.rationale: A-15-2: Computes due dates using payment term days and corporate holiday calendar to avoid weekend payouts.

nodes.label: Plan Spec 09: Unmapped PR Exception Handling
nodes.norm_label: plan spec 09: unmapped pr exception handling

nodes.label: Unified Response Envelope Standard
nodes.rationale: Standardizes API responses with data, error, and meta envelopes across all REST endpoints.

nodes.label: RS256 Asymmetric JWT Authentication
nodes.rationale: A-04-1: Private keys injected via environment variables (base64 PEM) rather than container filesystems.

nodes.label: Multi-Tenant Isolation Middleware
nodes.rationale: Extracts tenant context from JWT claims and binds tenant_id to PostgreSQL connection sessions.

nodes.label: Safe Expression Evaluation via simpleeval
nodes.rationale: A-05-1: Utilizes simpleeval instead of Python eval() to evaluate dynamic transition guards securely.

nodes.label: Unmatched Rule Lock and Escalation Protocol
nodes.norm_label: unmatched rule lock and escalation protocol
nodes.rationale: A-06-2: Locks entity in PENDING_RULE_RESOLUTION and fires alert event when no rule matches.

nodes.label: Bcrypt-Hashed Invitation Token Protocol
nodes.rationale: A-07-1: Stores invitation tokens as bcrypt hashes in database; raw token sent via email with 7-day TTL.

nodes.label: Dual-Authorization Bid Opening Protocol
nodes.rationale: A-10-2: Mandates two independent authorized users to unseal bids to ensure integrity and probity.

nodes.label: Sealed Bid Cryptographic Vault
nodes.rationale: A-11-1: Encrypts bid pricing and commercial attachments using field encryption until formal unsealing.

nodes.label: Normalized Currency L1 Calculation
nodes.rationale: A-12-1: Normalizes multi-currency bids to base currency (INR) using exchange rates before determining L1.

nodes.label: Three-Way Matching Reconciliation Engine
nodes.rationale: A-15-1: Matches PO, GRN, and invoice within quantity (±2%) and price (±0.5%) tolerance thresholds.

nodes.label: Bid Sealing Service
nodes.rationale: Uses AES-256-GCM encryption with per-RFQ keys in MinIO key-vault to preserve sealed bid confidentiality until formal opening.

nodes.label: Bid SHA-256 Hash Integrity
nodes.rationale: Computes SHA-256 over canonicalized bid payload at submission to ensure non-repudiation and tamper detection.

nodes.label: CS Normalization Algorithm
nodes.rationale: Normalizes landed cost using base price, freight terms, HSN tax rate, and NPV adjustment based on org cost of capital.

nodes.label: PO Price Validation
nodes.rationale: Validates PO unit price matches awarded unit price within +/-0.1% tolerance; requires justification beyond tolerance.

nodes.label: Emergency RFQ Fast Path
nodes.rationale: Bypasses standard 5-day bidding window down to 1 day with parallel HOD and Sourcing Manager approvals and mandatory justification.

nodes.label: Single Vendor Controls
nodes.rationale: Appends mandatory Compliance Officer approval and weekly reporting when only one bidder is invited.

nodes.label: Bid Opening Co-Authorization
nodes.rationale: Requires co-authorizer confirmation for high-value RFQ unsealing to eliminate single-actor collusion risks.

nodes.label: Server-Side Deadline Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Enforces UTC server clock over client timestamp to prevent tampering with bid submission deadlines.

nodes.label: CS Tie-Breaking Rules
nodes.rationale: Sequentially breaks price ties via delivery lead time, vendor performance score, and admin discretion.

nodes.label: Unit Test Coverage Targets
nodes.rationale: Mandates 80% minimum coverage overall and 95%+ coverage on critical financial and integrity engines.

nodes.label: Global Pytest Fixtures
nodes.rationale: Savepoint nested transactions allow tests to run concurrently with zero cross-test data pollution and zero migration re-run overhead

nodes.label: Dynamic Data Factories
nodes.rationale: FactoryBoy dynamic creation using uuid4 enforces the zero hardcoded data rule across test suites

nodes.label: 10 Canonical S2P Workflow Templates
nodes.rationale: Declarative JSONB workflow definitions enable dynamic approval paths without altering application code or deploying code migrations

nodes.label: Vendor 11-State Finite State Machine
nodes.rationale: Strict state machine blocks irreversible states such as BLACKLISTED from reactivation without explicit executive governance

nodes.label: PDF Watermarking Service
nodes.rationale: Applies dynamic user, timestamp, and document ID watermarks to contract PDFs on download using pikepdf and reportlab.

nodes.label: Document Access Matrix
nodes.rationale: Strictly controls read/write access across organizational roles, business units, and entity lifecycles.

nodes.label: Document Management Service
nodes.rationale: Presigned direct URLs with 15-minute TTL minimize API memory footprint and proxy bandwidth bottlenecks

nodes.label: SSRF-Safe HTTP Client
nodes.rationale: DNS pre-resolution and private subnet blocking prevents attackers from forging requests to cloud metadata or internal K8s services

nodes.label: Bank Account Penny Testing Service
nodes.rationale: Automated penny drop validation verifies account beneficiary name matches vendor legal registration before approving payouts

nodes.label: Document Quarantine Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Moving infected files to an isolated quarantine bucket prevents execution or accidental access

nodes.label: Field-Level Encryption (PII & Banking)
nodes.rationale: Fernet encryption on bank accounts, PAN, and tax identifiers ensures data remains unreadable even in raw database backups or dumps

nodes.label: Atomic Budget Reservation Engine
nodes.rationale: Redis distributed locking during budget verification prevents concurrent PRs from double-spending or exceeding fiscal department budgets

nodes.label: Unmapped PR Exception Queue
nodes.rationale: Isolating ERP import failures in an exception queue prevents invalid requisition lines from corrupting clean downstream sourcing and PO generation

nodes.label: Chunked CSV Export Streaming
nodes.rationale: StreamingResponse flushes rows in real-time batches preventing OOM when exporting large datasets

nodes.label: Procurement Analytics Service
nodes.rationale: Queries route to PostgreSQL read replica with 15-minute Redis cache to isolate analytical workloads from OLTP writes

nodes.label: Category Hierarchy Service
nodes.rationale: Structural 5-level hierarchy limit prevents unbounded tree recursion and expensive deep SQL ancestor queries

nodes.label: Rule Versioning & In-Flight Protection
nodes.rationale: Binding in-flight workflow instances to specific rule_version_id prevents policy changes from breaking or re-routing existing approval workflows

nodes.label: Document Retention Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Automates lifecycle retention (7-10 years) and permanent audit log archiving via monthly background tasks.

nodes.label: Elasticsearch Audit Search Service
nodes.rationale: Async Elasticsearch querying avoids expensive full-text ILIKE and regex table scans on multi-million row PostgreSQL audit tables

nodes.label: Audit Logs Monthly Partitioning & Immutability
nodes.rationale: Partitioning by month enables rapid drop of expired logs and prevents massive index bloat while triggers guarantee tamper resistance

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Shared-Database Multi-Tenancy
nodes.rationale: Discriminator column org_id with composite indexes and Row-Level Security provides strong multi-tenant isolation with minimal operational overhead

nodes.label: Critical Notifications Policy
nodes.rationale: Bypasses user mute preferences for critical compliance and deadline alerts (e.g. 4h deadline, SLA escalation).

nodes.label: Quality Inspection Gate
nodes.rationale: Blocks GRN approval without linked quality inspection records when category requires quality inspection.

nodes.label: Knowledge Graph Query Protocol
nodes.rationale: Instructs coding agents to consult graphify CLI/MCP query tools instead of raw grepping or loading monolithic reports.

nodes.label: Knowledge Graph Generation Workflow
nodes.rationale: Slash workflow that turns any repository directory into an interactive knowledge graph.

nodes.label: Graph Maintenance Rule
nodes.rationale: Mandates executing graphify update after editing code files to prevent architecture graph drift.

nodes.label: Cursor & Offset Pagination Handler
nodes.rationale: Cursor pagination using base64 encoded entity IDs avoids quadratic O(N) offset degradation on high-volume tables

nodes.label: Integration Job Processor
nodes.rationale: Persistent job records and exponential backoff retry ensure resilience against transient ERP downtime

nodes.label: Blue-Green Deployment Strategy
nodes.rationale: Achieves zero-downtime deployment and instant rollback (<2 min) via two parallel K3s namespaces (blue/green).

nodes.label: CI Test Execution and Regression Gates
nodes.norm_label: ci test execution and regression gates
nodes.rationale: Enforces automated blocking of pull requests and deploys if any regression occurs.

nodes.label: RFC 8594 Sunset & Deprecation Headers
nodes.rationale: Sunset headers give external ERP and portal consumers deterministic timeline warnings before breaking API retirement

nodes.label: Partitioned Celery Worker Deployments
nodes.rationale: Segregating Celery workers across maintenance, document_scan, and default queues isolates resource-heavy jobs from latency-critical tasks

nodes.label: Three-Way Match Engine
nodes.rationale: Automates 3-way matching across PO, GRN accepted quantity, and invoice lines with configurable price and tax tolerance.

nodes.label: Integration Settings Config API and UI
nodes.norm_label: integration settings config api and ui

nodes.label: Tax Code Compliance and HSN Mapping
nodes.norm_label: tax code compliance and hsn mapping

nodes.label: Master Data Maker-Checker Governance
nodes.rationale: Requires impact assessment query and Procurement Admin approval for any master data modification or deactivation.

nodes.label: Soft Delete Pattern via deleted_at
nodes.rationale: Soft deletion preserves audit trails and referential integrity for compliance while global ORM filters hide deleted rows from application logic

nodes.label: Core Web Vitals Performance Targets
nodes.rationale: Targets LCP < 2.5s, FID < 100ms, and CLS < 0.1 via Next.js route splitting, image optimization, and virtual scrolling.

nodes.label: WCAG 2.1 AA Accessibility Standards
nodes.rationale: Enforces Radix UI primitives, ARIA attributes, keyboard navigation, and verified contrast ratios.

nodes.label: Disaster Recovery Strategy
nodes.rationale: Maintains cold standby K3s with continuous PostgreSQL WAL shipping to meet 4-hour RTO.

nodes.label: Analytics Data Retention and Redaction
nodes.rationale: Retains anonymized aggregated analytics data indefinitely while applying PII redaction to user export views.

nodes.label: Security Test Checklist
nodes.rationale: Systematically audits IDOR, pre-opening bid confidentiality, SQLi, and JWT manipulation.

nodes.label: API Contract Protocol
nodes.rationale: Requires grepping all consumers and atomic multi-tier commits on any API schema change.

nodes.label: Six-Step Implementation Loop
nodes.rationale: Enforces 1 Plan, 2 Implement, 2.5 Spec Audit, 3 Test (3 personas), 4 Integrate, 5 Graphify update, 6 README update.

nodes.label: Apple Design System Philosophy
nodes.rationale: Adapts clarity, deference, and depth principles from Apple Human Interface Guidelines for enterprise procurement.

nodes.label: Fluid Spring Motion and Transitions
nodes.rationale: A-APPLE-2: Employs framer-motion spring physics for responsive, weighted modal and drawer transitions.

nodes.label: Multi-Squad Governance Model
nodes.rationale: Organizes delivery into four cross-functional squads (Squads A, B, C, D) across four milestone phases.

nodes.label: Procurement Portal Enterprise Scope
nodes.rationale: Defines platform boundaries spanning requisition, sourcing, contracting, ordering, and AP settlement.

nodes.label: Superadmin Initialization Protocol
nodes.rationale: A-01-1: SUPERADMIN role and root tenant seeded at application initialization rather than via migration.

nodes.label: Distributed MinIO Object Storage Strategy
nodes.rationale: A-02-2: Ten segregated S3-compatible buckets with server-side encryption (SSE-S3) and object versioning.

nodes.label: Event-Driven RabbitMQ Topology
nodes.rationale: A-02-1: RabbitMQ topology of 24 domain exchanges plus DLX initialized via dedicated script.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Relational Schema Design
nodes.rationale: Defines 70+ relational tables across all 25 modules with strict foreign keys and multi-tenant RLS.

nodes.label: Plan Apple Design System and Liquid Glass
nodes.norm_label: plan apple design system and liquid glass

nodes.label: Types-First Contract Principle
nodes.rationale: Mandates generating TypeScript interfaces from backend OpenAPI specs before developing frontend UI components to prevent contract mismatch.

nodes.label: Layer Discipline Architecture
nodes.rationale: Enforces router -> service -> repository -> model data flow; forbids layer skipping and upward imports.

nodes.label: Migration Safety Protocol
nodes.rationale: Demands full reversibility of downgrade(), prohibits table locks via CONCURRENTLY indexes, and isolates data migrations.

nodes.label: Zero Hardcoded Data Rule
nodes.rationale: Mandates all URLs, timeouts, limits, and roles be derived from Pydantic Settings or environment variables.

nodes.label: Liquid Glass UI Styling
nodes.rationale: Utilizes backdrop-filter blur, translucent borders, and specular highlights for a layered glassmorphic UI.

nodes.label: Clean Layered Architecture
nodes.rationale: Implements router -> service -> repository -> model hierarchy ensuring complete decoupling.

nodes.label: Ordered Alembic Migration Sequence
nodes.rationale: A-03-1: ENUMs created in dedicated first migration; circular foreign keys resolved via phased schema updates.

nodes.label: Modular Monolith Architecture
nodes.rationale: Modular monolith avoids distributed transaction overhead and operational complexity of microservices during initial phases while preserving clear service boundaries

nodes.label: Zero-Trust Network Policies
nodes.rationale: Default-deny network policies enforce strict ingress allowlists preventing lateral movement if a pod is compromised

nodes.label: Five Immutable Compliance Rules
nodes.rationale: Enforcing zero dead code, zero hardcoded values, and strict layer discipline ensures high maintainability and audit readiness

nodes.label: Four-Layer Architecture (router -> service -> repo -> model)
nodes.rationale: Strict forward dependency prevents cyclical imports and guarantees clear separation of protocol, business logic, and persistence

nodes.label: Idempotency Key Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Guarantees safe retries on state-changing operations via Redis TTL 24h caching.

nodes.label: API Versioning Policy
nodes.rationale: Path versioning /api/v1 with 6 months overlap support for backward compatibility during major API transitions.

nodes.label: API Rate Limiting Tiers
nodes.rationale: Protects system stability with distinct rate limit quotas per endpoint criticality (auth 5/min, upload 10/min, standard 100/min).

nodes.label: Notification Batch Digest Task
nodes.rationale: Batch aggregation avoids notification fatigue for low-priority alerts and periodic summary digests

nodes.label: Email Notification Channel
nodes.rationale: Resend/SendGrid/SES fallback with exponential backoff prevents notification drop during email provider downtime

nodes.label: Notification WebSocket Manager
nodes.rationale: Redis PubSub backing ensures multi-pod WebSocket message delivery across auto-scaled API instances

nodes.label: Transactional Outbox Pattern
nodes.rationale: Writing domain events to outbox_messages within the DB transaction guarantees at-least-once message delivery to RabbitMQ without dual-write inconsistency

nodes.label: Axios API Client with Auto-Refresh
nodes.rationale: In-memory access token with httpOnly refresh token in cookies protects session against XSS credential exfiltration

nodes.label: Segregation of Duties (SoD) Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Hardcoded DB and service rules prevent a user from approving their own PR or PO and enforce dual-signoff for vendor blacklisting
